evidence: Body queries status selector 0x0, and depending on its value queries another selector, indexes a table, then runs several helper checks to choose a returned code (decompiled/main/main_0119.c:15183-15223). Many callers pass the same context object, but their call sites do not identify the returned code meaning (for example decompiled/main/main_0119.c:32782-32784); leaving unnamed is safer.

Body queries selector 0x0, then conditionally obtains a byte status and routes it through two helpers to produce a derived byte result or zero (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:14739-14763). Indexed caller 0x7000fad928 stores the return value but does not establish what the status means (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:3759-3763); leaving unnamed.

For nonnull x1, body reads a pointer at x1+0x30, calls the float/property helper with selector 0x1b, and returns whether the resulting scalar compares greater than zero; null input or nested pointer returns false (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:15736-15757). Indexed caller 0x7000fafaf0 invokes it and stores the Boolean result (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:6586-6590). No prototype or field claims.

Body queries status selectors 1 and 2, subtracts 0x83 from each result, and returns true only when both resulting unsigned values are below 4 (decompiled/main/main_0006.c:32056-32071). Caller 0x70000b49e0 branches on its Boolean result (decompiled/main/main_0006.c:45714-45718), but does not expose the meanings of those selector values; leaving unnamed.

Body calls attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x15 and returns whether the 32-bit result is nonzero (decompiled/main/main_0006.c:31158-31163). Indexed callers use the result as a Boolean predicate, including a branch at decompiled/main/main_0006.c:35698-35700. The selector's domain meaning is unresolved, so the name preserves its numeric identity.
